title: HorizonComposer: Spatiotemporally Consistent Driving Video Editing with Enriched Traffic Semantics
title_zh: HorizonComposer：具有丰富交通语义的时空一致驾驶视频编辑

paragraphs.en: 提出HorizonComposer，通过混合数据、密集奖励对齐与思考帧机制实现时空一致且保护交通语义的驾驶视频编辑。 Instruction-guided video generative models offer a scalable solution for stress-testing autonomous driving systems by simulating diverse environmental conditions. However, driving scenes operate within a dense Operational Design Domain (ODD) governed by strict traffic semantics. When applied to global driving-condition edits, general-purpose instruction-guided video editors frequently corrupt these semantics, leading to structural hallucinations and ``temporal shock.'' This work distills and protects traffic semantics during video editing at three levels. First, we construct a hybrid dataset by combining temporally aligned real-world videos with synthetic edits, balancing foundational scene structure with unambiguous appearance signals. Second, during training, we adapt advantage conditioning from offline reinforcement learning to align the model using dense rewards. We extract dense, pixel-level rewards from the hybrid data to serve as a localized signal and actively steer generation toward structurally reliable pixels. Finally, our model mitigates temporal shock by introducing thinking frames, a transition mechanism that seamlessly reconciles static image conditioning with dynamic video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method prevents the corruption of multi-actor dynamics, establishing state-of-the-art spatiotemporal consistency, yielding consistent user preference (39% relative improvement in content preservation and 12% in temporal consistency), and achieving a significant 5% gain in downstream road line segmentation and 7% gain in downstream multi-object detection.
paragraphs.zh: 提出HorizonComposer，通过混合数据、密集奖励对齐与思考帧机制实现时空一致且保护交通语义的驾驶视频编辑。指令引导的视频生成模型通过模拟多样的环境条件，为自动驾驶系统的压力测试提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。 然而，驾驶场景运行在受严格交通语义约束的密集运行设计域（ODD）之内。 当应用于全局驾驶条件编辑时，通用的指令引导视频编辑器经常会破坏这些语义，导致结构性幻觉和“时间冲击”。本工作在三个层面上在视频编辑过程中提炼并保护交通语义。 首先，我们通过将时间对齐的真实世界视频与合成编辑相结合来构建混合数据集，在基础场景结构与明确的外观信号之间取得平衡。 其次，在训练过程中，我们将离线强化学习中的优势条件化加以改造，以利用密集奖励来对齐模型。 我们从混合数据中提取密集的像素级奖励，将其作为局部化信号，主动引导生成朝着结构可靠的像素进行。 最后，我们的模型通过引入思考帧来缓解时间冲击，这是一种能够无缝调和静态图像条件与动态视频上下文的过渡机制。 大量实验表明，我们的方法防止了多参与者动态的破坏，建立了最先进的时空一致性，产生了稳定的用户偏好（内容保留相对提升39%，时间一致性提升12%），并在下游道路标线分割中取得5%的显著提升，在下游多目标检测中取得7%的提升。
